source: PURE Plain Dataset — 2008 KeePass Password Safe 1.10 SRS (CC-BY 4.0), manual gold annotation
expected_functions: Create new database with Master Password
Import data from CSV/Code Wallet/Password Safe/Personal Vault
Open database via command line argument
Use Composite Master Key (password + key file + Windows account)
Add and use TAN one-time passwords
Copy stored passwords to clipboard / send to applications
Execute URLs and command lines from URL field
expected_constraints: Database encrypted with AES/Rijndael 256-bit key and Twofish 256-bit key
No recovery mechanism if Master Password is lost
Single instance only (Global Hot Key to restore)
expected_exceptions: File not found when opening database
Empty group name when creating group
No search results when keyword not found
expected_processes: Create database → set Master Password → add groups/entries → save
Open database → enter Master Password → access/modify entries → save
Auto-Type workflow: configure sequence → KeePass sends keystrokes to target window
Password usage workflow: copy password → paste to website/app (auto-cleared after 10s)
